action_items.description: ROOT CAUSE FIRST — When a task title contains 'original fix task reopened (fix didn't resolve root cause)', STOP before writing any code. Execute in order: (1) grep 'git log --oneline -30' for the original task short ID from the title; (2) run 'git show <commit>:<changed-files>' to read the previous attempt's exact changes; (3) identify specifically WHY that approach failed (symptom patch vs root cause?); (4) document root cause analysis in a comment block; (5) write your fix to address the root cause only. A fix that repeats the same approach will fail QC for the same reason and waste $2+ in pipeline cost.
action_items.reason: 3 of 5 dev execution failures this cycle match 'Cancelled: original fix task reopened (fix didn't resolve root cause)'. Agents re-implement without reading prior attempts, producing identical patches that fail QC again.

action_items.description: GATE PRE-CHECK — At the start of any task whose title begins with 'Fix: Quality gate', immediately re-run the failing gate before touching any code. Gate commands by type: security='npm audit --audit-level=high', lint='npm run lint', test='npm test', clean_worktree='git status --porcelain'. If the gate exits 0 (now passes), call reportSuccess() with notes='no-op: gate auto-resolved before agent started' — do NOT make code changes. Phantom gate-fix tasks leave the codebase in inconsistent state.
action_items.reason: 1 of 5 dev failures was 'Auto-resolved: gate now passes'. Agent spawned after gate self-resolved but applied unnecessary changes.

action_items.description: GIT NETWORK RESILIENCE — When any git remote operation (push, fetch, clone, ls-remote, branch creation) times out or returns a connection error, retry with exponential backoff: attempt 1 immediately, attempt 2 after 30s with HTTPS fallback (git remote set-url origin https://github.com/LeonidaTheGreat/leadflow.git), attempt 3 after 60s. Only mark the task failed if all 3 retries fail — report branch-creation-failed with the exact error from the last attempt. Never fail a task on the first network timeout.
action_items.reason: 1 of 5 dev failures was 'branch-creation-failed: timeout exceeded when trying to connect'. Transient network timeout — HTTPS fallback + retry would have recovered.

action_items.description: PARENT TASK STATUS CHECK — At task start, before checking out any branch or running any git command, query the parent dev task status: psql openclaw -c "SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id = '<parent_task_id>'". If status is NOT 'done', call reportSuccess() immediately with notes='skipped: parent dev task status=<status>, QC review cannot proceed'. Do not attempt branch checkout, PR review, or any git operations for a failed, cancelled, or in-progress parent task.
action_items.reason: All 4 QC failures this cycle were cascade failures from upstream dev task failures. A one-line parent check at task start eliminates all wasted QC spawn cycles.
